subject: Human Evolution
title: Thrifty Genes
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Thrifty Genes.

hook.text: Pacific Islanders have some of the highest obesity rates on Earth. James Neel thought he knew why.

buildup.text: His 'thrifty gene' hypothesis says populations exposed to famine evolved super-efficient fat storage.

discovery.text: When food became abundant, those efficient genes kept storing—causing obesity and diabetes in one generation.

twist.text: The hypothesis is contested: some researchers find no clear 'thrifty' genes. The picture is complex.

climax.text: What's clear is that rapid dietary change outpaces genetic adaptation, creating health crises.

punchline.text: Genes built for famine don't suit a feast.

quiz.question: What does the thrifty gene hypothesis propose?
options: Famine-adapted genes cause obesity when food is abundant
